resources.string: AnkiQuest has encountered a problem; a report is being sent to the AnkiQuest developers…
An error report is being prepared for the AnkiQuest developers…

Reports go to the AnkiQuest server and are deleted after 30 days. A report contains the error and where in the app it happened, recent app log lines, your settings without account details, your comment, when the app started and when the error happened, and technical details about the app and your device: app version, device model, Android version and build, screen and language settings, memory, storage paths and WebView version.
